sources.title: God of War Laufey's Faye actor jumps from games to live-action, as Amazon casts Deborah Ann Woll in upcoming series
sources.text: After appearing in both God of War Ragnarok and next year's God of War Laufey, Deborah Ann Woll is about to reprise her role as Faye in Amazon Prime Video's upcoming live-action series. Variety reports that the God of War cast list is now welcoming a second actor pulled straight from Sony Santa Monica's video game series. Deborah Ann Woll first showed up in the games as Kratos' wife and Atreus' mother during God of War Ragnarok, but she's also about to enter the spotlight proper in God of War Laufey. Amazon's God of War cast now includes Dave Bautista (Guardians of the Galaxy) as god killer Kratos, Callum Vinson (Chucky) as Atreus, Mandy Patinkin as Odin and Ólafur Darri Ólafsson as Thor. Alastair Duncan is also making the game-to-show jump by stepping back into the figurative shoes of chatty head Mimir. Earlier in the year, the God of War show halted production when former Kratos actor Ryan Hurst suffered an on-set injury. Bautista soon took over the role and production began again in October - all of Hurst's scenes had to be reshot, of course. There's no release date yet for the show, but it's said to follow the Norse era of the games which began in 2018's more serious and stern revamp. Amazon ordered a two-season run for the show, which apparently means both seasons will be filmed back-to-back. Meanwhile, God of War Laufey was recently delayed from February 2027 to May 2027, giving the PS5 exclusive slightly more breathing room away from Fable, Persona 4 Revival and Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis. "We will make the most of each moment until then by putting in the finishing touches and pushing the game to its fullest potential," developer Sony Santa Monica said at the time. "On behalf of everyone on the team, we appreciate your patience and we'll be back to share more updates soon." While the game puts Faye in the leading role as she battles with gods in a multi-mythological afterlife, the studio was quick to note that her journey isn't considered a side game. God of War Laufey will still connect to future games in the series and, yep, Kratos will eventually be back , too. "Genuinely, I thought I was going to be much more offended by it, but one, I'm not on social media, so that helps, and two, I don't know, I feel totally unbothered," Woll said of the online trolls who were targeting Laufey after its reveal this summer. "Because I just know it's great. It's okay if it's not your cup of tea, but in no universe is it bad."

stories.title: Rockstar is actively shopping Red Dead Redemption movie and TV rights around, just don't expect the same for Grand Theft Auto
stories.summary: Rockstar Games is seemingly interested in expanding Red Dead Redemption beyond video games, after years of Hollywood knocking on its doors. According to a new report, the company is looking for someone to pick up the movie and TV rights for its open-world Westerner series. Read more

sources.name: Eurogamer
sources.title: Rockstar is actively shopping Red Dead Redemption movie and TV rights around, just don't expect the same for Grand Theft Auto
sources.text: Rockstar Games is seemingly interested in expanding Red Dead Redemption beyond video games, after years of Hollywood knocking on its doors. According to a new report, the company is looking for someone to pick up the movie and TV rights for its open-world Westerner series. The information comes from a new report in The Ankler , citing agents in the know. According to the report, Rockstar wanted something in the range of $100m (£76m) as a minimum for the license to its Red Dead Redemption series of games. As the report pointed out, Amazon paid $250m (£191m) in 2017 for Lord of the Rings' TV show rights alone. Rockstar, however, is not interested in turning Grand Theft Auto into a movie or TV show, per the same report. It's not clear why the company is willing to entertain the idea for one franchise and not the other, but the vastly larger popularity of GTA (compared to RDR, at least) could explain why. It's worth noting that streamers like Netflix and Amazon have been on something of a hot streak recently with the success of shows based on popular video games, such as Fallout . HBO managed to turn The Last of Us into a prestige series that can attract both fans of the game and casual TV viewers. Indeed, many more video game-based shows are in the works, like Amazon's Tomb Raider series , its God of War adaptation , as well as FX's Far Cry anthology show . Even Call of Duty, a massive - though nowhere near as massive as GTA - franchise, is getting a live-action movie in 2028 . But none of those are as profitable or culturally-dominnant as Grand Theft Auto. GTA 6 just released, and immediately beat analyst expectations. The game made $3.79bn (£2.90bn) in revenue on day one off the back of 32.5m copies sold, making it the biggest launch of any entertainment product in history, so it's understandable why Rockstar is not too eager to turn it into a movie or TV show.

sources.name: Video Games Chronicle
sources.title: Rockstar is reportedly interested in a Red Dead Redemption film or TV show
sources.text: It’s reported that Rockstar doesn’t want a GTA movie, but is open to Red Dead pitches A Red Dead Redemption film or TV show is possible, with Rockstar reportedly considering its options. As reported by The Ankler , Rockstar is open to reaching a licensing agreement to adapt Red Dead Redemption. According to one of the sources, Rockstar has suggested a price tag of “more than $100 million minimum” for these movie rights. The report states that this agreement could include a film or TV show. It’s also claimed that Rockstar has no interest in a Grand Theft Auto film or TV adaptation and is only considering Red Dead Redemption as a candidate. Given the monumental success of GTA 5 and now GTA 6, it’s likely that Hollywood would be interested in adapting the series. The only hurdle would be getting Rockstar and Take-Two on board, although this report would suggest that neither sees the value in this. However, if Red Dead Redemption is the only series up for grabs, it’s still very possible that some studios would be willing to foot the bill. Red Dead Redemption 2 had the second-biggest launch of an entertainment project, only sitting behind GTA 5 at the time. It’s proven to have cultural staying power too, eight years after launch. The report makes no mention of whether Rockstar would prefer a potential Red Dead Redemption adaptation to follow the story of the games or tell a unique story within the same setting. Modern video game adaptations can take wildly different approaches, with The Last of Us show mostly remaining faithful, whereas the recent Resident Evil movie only had brief allusions to the games. Rockstar has not commented on this report, and hasn’t expressed a desire to bring either of its big franchises to the big screen. Right now, it is enjoying the launch of GTA 6, which has proven to be even more successful than its predecessor .

sources.name: Insider Gaming
sources.title: Rockstar Reportedly Open to Selling Red Dead Redemption TV Rights
sources.text: There’s a ton of hype around Rockstar Games’ Grand Theft Auto 6 (GTA 6) since its release on November 19. According to The Ankler , while Rockstar isn’t interested in making GTA movies, it may be interested in bringing another popular title, Red Dead Redemption, to the big screen. To bring a video game to TV or movies, a studio would pay the companies involved for the story rights. An agent who works with video game writers stated, “At one point they were throwing around a purchase price of more than $100 million minimum for licensing rights.” The latest game in the Red Dead series, Red Dead Redemption 2, passed 87 million copies sold in August 2026, putting the entire series close to 116 million sales. Rockstar Games’ stories get picked up by many fans, as GTA 6 had pre-launch sales of over 10 million copies . Brought to theaters or TV, Red Dead Redemption would provide a captivating story. The first title in the series is a Western action-adventure set in 1911. The main character, John Marston, is looking for his wife and son after they’ve been taken. Red Dead Redemption 2 is actually a prequel taking place in 1899. This story follows Arthur Morgan, a gang member, who is trying to decide if his loyalty lies with the Dutch van der Linde or himself. Would you like to see a Red Dead movie or series? Let us know down in the comments and in the official Insider Gaming Discord . In other news, check out the Senua concept art that recently surfaced online . For even more Insider Gaming delivered directly to your inbox, sign up for our newsletter .

sources.name: GamesRadar
sources.title: Rockstar is reportedly looking into turning Red Dead Redemption into a movie or TV show
sources.text: The studio is supposedly shopping the rights for $100 million Rockstar is reportedly looking to adapt Red Dead Redemption for the big and small screens. According to The Ankler, Rockstar has been "throwing around a purchase price of more than $100 million minimum for licensing rights" to the Red Dead Redemption franchise with the hopes of making a movie or a TV show. In Red Dead Redemption, the player controls a former outlaw named John Marston whose wife and son are held hostage by the government in exchange for Marston's bounty hunter services. It's an open-world game that's set in the year 1911 and has some horror elements (and some weird things happen when you let the game idle for a bit, depending on what you're doing in that moment). Red Dead Redemption 2, a prequel to the first game, was released in 2018. A Red Dead movie has been in demand for quite some time, dating all the way back to its 2010 release (with Brad Pitt initially tapped by fans as the perfect John Marston). Jack Black even said that Red Dead had a "better story than The Last of Us" and therefore deserved its own live-action adaptation. Given that Far Cry, God of War, and Assassin's Creed are all in the works, and the fact that The Last of Us received some Emmy nominations... I'd say now is as good a time as any to turn your blockbuster video game into a live-action something or other. sources.name: PlayStation Blog BR
sources.title: Agradecemos por tornarem Grand Theft Auto VI o maior lançamento da história PlayStation
sources.text: Uma homenagem à comunidade PlayStation e à Rockstar Games por proporcionarem um momento incrível para o universo dos games e do entretenimento. Após uma longa espera, os jogadores finalmente tiveram a chance de mergulhar em Grand Theft Auto VI . Foi incrível ver a comunidade PlayStation ao redor do mundo começar suas aventuras no estado de Leonida. Quer você tenha contado os dias para retornar às ruas de Vice City, ou esteja vivenciando a série Grand Theft Auto pela primeira vez, queremos aproveitar este momento para agradecer. A empolgação e a paixão da comunidade tornaram este um momento verdadeiramente especial para todos nós. O lançamento de GTAVI marca um momento extraordinário para os jogos e o entretenimento, tornando-se o maior lançamento de um jogo na história de PlayStation, ao longo de três décadas e cinco gerações de consoles. Mais de 39 milhões de jogadores únicos vivenciaram a história de Jason e Lucia em Grand Theft Auto VI para PlayStation 5. A comunidade PlayStation se uniu de forma expressiva para vivenciar Grand Theft Auto VI durante seu lançamento e fim de semana de estreia. Confira alguns destaques do período de lançamento, encerrado em 22 de novembro de 2026*: Estas são apenas algumas das maneiras pelas quais vimos nossa comunidade PlayStation se unir em torno deste momento incrível no mundo dos jogos, e estamos empolgados para ver como vocês continuarão criando e compartilhando novas memórias e experiências nos próximos meses. Por fim, gostaríamos de parabenizar nossos parceiros da Rockstar Games por trazerem este jogo extraordinário a jogadores de todo o mundo e por darem continuidade a uma parceria com a PlayStation que vem desde o Grand Theft Auto III, para PlayStation 2. Com GTAVI, trabalhamos para oferecer a melhor experiência no console PS5 e proporcionamos aos jogadores uma forma memorável de celebrar o título, por meio de dois controles sem fio DualSense de edição limitada, inspirados em Vice City. Também celebramos o lançamento com eventos ao vivo, incluindo o “Grand Theft Auto VI: The Festival”, realizado em Miami no último fim de semana. E à nossa comunidade PlayStation, obrigado pela paixão e pelo apoio contínuos, e por escolherem vivenciar GTAVI no console PS5 . É o entusiasmo de vocês que torna momentos como este tão significativos para todos nós. Mal podemos esperar para ver aonde suas aventuras em Leonida levarão vocês! *Todos os números baseiam-se em dados internos da SIE coletados de 19 de novembro de 2026 a 22 de novembro de 2026.

sources.name: Gematsu
sources.title: Grand Theft Auto VI for PS5 tops 39 million players
sources.text: More than 39 million unique users have played Grand Theft Auto VI on PlayStation 5 as of November 22, making it the biggest launch in PlayStation history across three decades and five console generations, Sony Interactive Entertainment announced . The sequel set a new record for the highest number of concurrent players for any game on PlayStation, surpassing previous records across multiplayer, free-to-play, and single-player titles. Across PlayStation 5, players cumulatively logged 683 million hours of gameplay in Grand Theft Auto VI , and have spent an average of 17.4 hours exploring the game’s world during its opening days. Grand Theft Auto VI ‘s launch also marked the largest number of newly connected PlayStation 5 consoles on a single day since the console’s launch, outside of end-of-year holidays. Since launch, it was the first played game on 70 percent of new PlayStation 5 consoles. “We want to congratulate our partners at Rockstar Games for bringing this extraordinary game to players around the world and continuing a partnership with PlayStation that stretches back to Grand Theft Auto III on PlayStation 2 ,” Sony Interactive Entertainment content communications manager Tim Turi said. “With [ Grand Theft Auto VI ], we worked to bring the best experience on [PlayStation 5] and gave players a memorable way to commemorate the game with two special limited-edition DualSense wireless controllers inspired by Vice City. We also celebrated the launch with live events including Grand Theft Auto VI : The Festival in Miami this past weekend.” Grand Theft Auto VI launched for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series on November 19. On November 20, Rockstar Games announced that the game achieved $3.79 billion in day one retail sales following 32.5 million pre-sales. Although Rockstar Games did not share exact unit numbers, the revenue total suggests roughly 37.9 million to 47.3 million copies sold, based solely on pricing across its $79.99 and $99.99 editions.

sources.name: IGN
sources.title: PS5 Games on Sale for $15 for Black Friday
sources.text: In the olden days (a few years ago) you had to wait until the actual day of Black Friday before the killer deals would crop up. Those days are officially gone. Today, on the Monday before Black Friday official, Walmart kicked off its “ Black Friday Event 2 ,” dropping some absolutely killer deals, and Amazon is price matching most of them. Among the discounts are a bunch of PS5 games on sale for just $15. These games are excellent and not that old. So grab what you want, because you’re not likely to find them cheaper any time soon. What games are we talking? For starters, Mafia: The Old Country, an excellent single-player game that came out last year that our reviewer called “an effective return to the linear and tightly story-driven format of the original Mafia and Mafia II.” Then there’s Assassin’s Creed Shadows , in which Ubisoft’s long-running series finally goes to Japan. We gave it an 8/10 in our review , saying, “By sharpening the edges of its existing systems, Assassin’s Creed Shadows creates one of the best versions of the open-world style it’s been honing for the last decade.” Then there’s Borderlands 4 and Star Wars Outlaws and WWE 2K26, all fine games worth checking out if you haven’t already. Fifteen bucks will even get you Elden Ring, Fromsoft’s sprawling, open-world masterpiece that we gave a 10/10 in our review when it came out in 2022. That same year, we awarded it Game of the Year . Other all-time low prices can be had now as well, like AirPods Pro 3 for $149 and Metal Gear Solid Master Collection Vol 2. for $29.99 . Chris Reed is a senior commerce editor and deals expert for IGN. He also runs IGN's LEGO coverage and maintains the upcoming release dates articles for video games , LEGO sets , and 4K Blu-rays . sources.name: GamesRadar
sources.title: The PS5 controller Black Friday deals are plentiful over at Currys
sources.text: The Wolverine model is also seeing a discount right now If you've been looking to pick up a new DualSense Wireless Controller for your PS5 in the Black Friday sales, then you'll have noticed that the discounts are quite uneven. While most retailers are discounting the extras to roughly the same £43 price point, the actual models of controllers reduced vary wildly by store. There seems to be an exception, though. The Currys PlayStation Black Friday sales have struck a wide array of color models for DualSense controllers; the selection is much more varied than Amazon's, with colorways reduced that aren't discounted elsewhere. That includes the DualSense's premium versions, like the sought-after Icon Blue retro model, as well as the perhaps controversial yellow-and-black Wolverine limited edition controller. Currys' PS5 DualSense controller discounts match other retailers', but with much more selection. By my count, eight different colorways are reduced from the eleven stocked at the retailer, including the vibrant pink and camo-patterned models, as well as some standard alternatives. Some of Sony's more premium DualSense colorways are seeing discounts too: the Icon Blue and Wolverine Limited Edition models are among them. These function the same as the normal models, but with more unique designs. Not only are they not on sale at rival retailers, but some don't even stock them at full price. If you buy one of these controllers from Currys, you get an additional benefit which we'll loosely chalk up as a 'Black Friday extra'. Currys is offering two months of Apple Music, Apple Fitness+, and Apple Arcade to people who purchase one of a selected range of products, which includes the DualSense controllers. This is for new or returning subscribers to those services, and when you make the purchase, you should receive a code in your inbox. The premium DualSense controllers are functionally identical to the standard ones. Don't buy one and expect to suddenly get better at your favorite game. The real reason to buy one is to celebrate your fandom of whatever the controller is inspired by. If you loved the Wolverine game earlier this year (or, more realistically, the character), that controller might be a fun one to add to your collection. Icon Blue was part of a series Sony put out about a year ago, celebrating the cerulean tone which is closely associated with the PlayStation brand, but it was pretty hard to find stock of when it first launched. Unfortunately, other limited edition DualSense colorways aren't seeing the same level of discounts at Currys, but are a bit more affordable than their launch prices of £74.99. For example, the 007 First Light controller isn't officially reduced with a Black Friday discount, but it is sitting at £56 at the retailer . Meanwhile, Amazon has it listed for £87.99. Other limited edition DualSense colorways at Currys under that £74.99 price include the Chroma, Pearl, and Remix versions. Unsurprisingly, the GTA 6 model isn't seeing any kind of price reduction at the moment. If you're worried about buying a controller now, thinking they could get cheaper in the coming week of sales, I'd imagine that's unlikely. Most retailers reduce DualSenses to the same price each year, and we're already seeing multiple hit this £43 mark; it seems that's where they'll stay. We're keeping tabs on all the best Black Friday deals for gamers , which includes all the Black Friday PS5 deals worth going for. And if you need a PS5 controller but don't feel like you need to stick to a DualSense, we've got a round-up of the best PS5 controllers you can buy. He was on the team at TechRadar and WhattoWatch, two of GamesRadar's sister brands, before becoming a freelance writer in late 2025. sources.title: How to Play Grand Theft Auto VI in the Cloud and with Remote Play
sources.text: Grand Theft Auto VI supports XBOX Cloud Gaming , making it available to play even without a current-gen console. With XBOX Cloud Gaming, you can play by streaming it straight from the cloud to your XBOX One, or XBOX Series X|S if you’d like to save some hard drive space. Select Game Pass plans include a monthly allotment of up to 15 play hours, and you can buy more cloud playtime if you need it, giving you the opportunity to experience one of the biggest games of the year on the consoles you already own. The game uses XBOX Series S graphics settings when cloud-streamed with XBOX Cloud Gaming. You can also access Remote Play to enjoy Grand Theft Auto VI wherever you want to play , allowing you to stream gameplay directly from your XBOX Series X|S console to devices you already own, like your mobile phone, laptops, PCs, or even a handheld gaming PC like the XBOX ROG Ally. Here’s how to get these features up and running (a copy of Grand Theft Auto VI from the XBOX Store is required): To start your Cloud gaming session in Grand Theft Auto VI , you can use the controllers that are connected to your console following these steps: When possible, connecting a wired Ethernet cable is the best option for gaming quality. FYI, even wireless networks with high bandwidth can occasionally have a dip in audio and video quality. Remote Play allows you to stream gameplay from your XBOX Series X|S to devices you already own, like mobile devices, PCs, and handheld gaming PCs. Here’s how to enable it: Once you’ve completed those steps above, you can move forward with Remote Play on one of your devices: Whether you’re streaming from the Cloud to save space or picking up right where you left off on your handheld PC, XBOX Cloud Gaming and Remote Play give you more ways to play Grand Theft Auto VI on the devices you already own. sources.title: How to get the GTA 6 BF Bandito
sources.text: You won't find the BF Bandito in a lock up in GTA 6, as this vehicle heist is a little tricker to pull off While you're out stealing cars for Moses, the GTA 6 BF Bandito will appear on your list, taking you out to the very rural roads of South Leonard County and the Buckskin Swamp. This GTA 6 heist is slightly harder than the others you might have carried out so far though, as this car will be on the move. Like all of Moses' targets, the rough location of the BF Bandito is marked on the map, but as you make your way there, you'll pass by some whoopin' and hollerin' country dwellers who are already taking the buggy for a spin. Here's how to get your hands on the GTA 6 Bandito and get paid. The map marker will take you to the rough location of the BF Bandito, where you should keep your eyes and ears open for some locals riding around the swamps on buggies - one of these is the Bandito. To claim it for yourself, you'll need to stop the Bandito driver, and there are a few ways to do this. If you clock him fast enough, particularly when crossing water, you can simply get in front of him, and he'll stop. Otherwise, you can chase down the Bandito, shooting the driver and his pals. Weirdly, though, when I did this challenge, the driver eventually just stopped and bolted, leaving the buggy free for me to take, though I'm not sure exactly what triggered him to do this. Essentially, just stay close, don't destroy the car by shooting it too much, and it'll be yours in no time. stories.title: Unofficial GTA 6 PC port scrapped as Rockstar allegedly takes down Discord server
stories.summary: But there are others waiting to take its place

sources.name: GamesRadar
sources.title: Unofficial GTA 6 PC port scrapped as Rockstar allegedly takes down Discord server
sources.text: But there are others waiting to take its place One unofficial GTA 6 PC port has been scrapped, hours after major progress in getting the game up and running was shown, as its lead quits and alleges that Rockstar Games has taken down the project's Discord server. Project Leonida was one of the main GTA 6 recompilation efforts, and yesterday, as notorious leaker Cyberleek dropped an executable file for the Xbox build of the game they'd shared last week, it seemed like it wouldn't be long before the fan-made PC port was functional . The devs behind Leonida never expected things to work immediately, but mere hours after the EXE file was dropped, an update in the Discord server claimed: "The game almost boots. Black screen, audio cuts off." In the hours that followed, it'd seem even more progress was made. One video shared on Reddit , apparently posted on the Leonida Discord server, appears to show the full opening sequence and the first-time game setup running on PC. However, don't expect any further updates from the project – or at least, not from its original creator – as the Discord server has now completely disappeared, and the project's lead says they're "stepping away" from it entirely. "I quit guys. I'm sorry," NotRexed writes on Twitter . "I really want to make cool stuff but every single time shit happens that I can't control so I'm stepping away. Thank you everybody, especially in the discord that allowed me to have this opportunity." In a follow-up post , they claim that Rockstar was behind the Discord server's takedown, saying: "Rockstar taking my server down was only part of the reason. Like I've said before, I'm a 15-year-old kid. Managing school and sports is hard enough without having middle-aged men yell and complain to you on Discord. Goodbye." Their original GitHub repository has also vanished, though others' clones of Leonida still appear to be live. Even with the original version of Leonida scrapped, though, there are still other projects racing to be the first to actually work. In fact, there's a whole tracker dedicated to monitoring the progress of various projects and how close they are to being ready to work. One such project recently said: "The title boots, runs its menus at its own 30 fps and loads the world, where rendering fails." While none are working yet, I still expect takedowns aplenty in the coming days and weeks, even if it's exceedingly difficult to completely wipe something from the internet once it's been posted. sources.name: Eurogamer
sources.title: Unofficial GTA 6 PC port effort suffers setback as Rockstar seemingly takes down Project Leonida, one of the internet's biggest recompilation projects
sources.text: A lot has happened in the last 24 hours in the community working to get Grand Theft Auto 6 running on PC. And now, Rockstar has dealt a major blow to their efforts. After infamous leaker CyberLeek made good on their promise and released a full Xbox build of GTA 6 , the build immediately spread online amongst modders and recompilers. Their goal? Get the game playable on PC as soon as possible. The largest hub of all that activity has been the Project Leonida Discord server, which had its own repository and a team of volunteer modders working - with help from Claude AI - to recompile GTA 6's leaked Xbox build to run on PC. Rockstar has allegedly taken down the server, causing the project's leaders to dismantle the entire operation. Project Leonida's lead NotRexed posted on X to announce they're ending development, after fans noticed the Discord server has been removed, as has Project Leonida's GitHub repository . "I quit guys. I'm sorry," NotRexed wrote. "I really want to make cool stuff but every single time shit happens that I can't control so I'm stepping away. Thank you everybody, especially in the discord that allowed me to have this opportunity." The modder, who claims to be a "15 year-old kid", later wrote in a follow-up X post that Rockstar is behind the server's takedown, though that's not the only reason for the project's end. "Last post from me. I wanna clear things up," they wrote. "Rockstar taking my server down was only part of the reason. Like I've said before, I'm a 15 year-old kid. Managing school and sports is hard enough without having middle aged men yell and complain to you on Discord. Goodbye." Before the Project Leonida server disappeared, footage emerged showing GTA 6 running on PC . The game is able to reach the initial setup screen, but quickly goes into a black screen afterwards. As unimpressive as the result was, it was achieved within hours of the full Xbox build's leak. Incidentally, while Project Leonida was the biggest and most prominent of the various GTA 6 recompilation projects, the leaking of the full Xbox build has given rise to various other groups. PortWatch VI is a website dedicated to tracking their progress, and though the data is almost entirely self-reported, a few other teams appear to have made notable progress themselves, so this may not be the end of the story. Rockstar has yet to comment publicly on the Xbox build's leak, and the company has not announced GTA 6 for PC. However, a report suggested GTA 6 arrives on PC in the first quarter of 2027 , earlier than everyone expected. If you're among the millions already playing the game on consoles, Eurogamer's GTA 6 walkthrough contains a wealth of information covering all major mechanics, main missions , secrets, cheats and more besides.

sources.title: Rockstar Shuts Down Discord Server Trying to Port GTA 6 to PC
sources.text: Rockstar Games shut down a Discord server after discovering it was working on a port of Grand Theft Auto 6 (GTA 6) to PC. Known as “Project Leonida”, this server was attempting to recompile the game in order to make it run fully on the platform. Of course, Rockstar and Take-Two, being the protective companies that they are, it was only a matter of time before they got wind of the work and had it stopped. The project was far enough along that the game had started booting on some PCs. A lot is likely due to the massive leaks done by Cyberleek, which appeared to release a full Xbox build of the game. After Rockstar shut the server down, the creator took to social media to reveal they were banned for two years from Discord and they were quitting. And, as it turns out, the ringleader was nothing more than a kid. “I quit guys. I’m sorry,” they said , adding in another post that they were just 15 and going to focus on school. “I really want to make cool stuff, but every single time shit happens that I can’t control, so I’m stepping away. Thank you everybody, especially in the Discord, that allowed me to have this opportunity.” Fans have waited 13 years for GTA 6 to launch. With the game only available on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, similar to when GTA 5 was released in 2013, PC players felt left out. There are reports that the PC version of the game could come as soon as early 2027 , but that idea didn’t seem to be enough for fans. Despite this one prominent attempt being shut down, it’s not likely to stop others from working to get the game running on PC. It’s expected to continue to rise, especially with the AI tools available to many users. What do you think of people working on unofficial PC ports for GTA 6? sources.title: GTA 6 was the "biggest launch in PlayStation history", with the highest number of concurrent players ever
sources.text: Release day saw a spike in newly connected PS5 consoles, although falling short of year-end highs Christmas did not come early for Sony, but it came close: the firm has declared that GTA 6 was the largest game launch in the platform's history, driving a record number of concurrent players on its November 19th launch, although the number of new consoles playing the game fell short of year-end highs. A post on the PlayStation Blog said the game has attracted more than 39 million unique players since launch, who have cumulatively logged 683 million hours of gameplay. The average total playtime was 17.4 hours, the firm said. The GTA 6 launch day saw a strong but not unprecedented spike in new console usage, which Sony described as the largest number of connected consoles in a single day aside from the console launch and end-of-year holidays. GTA 6 was the first game played on 70% of new PlayStation consoles. Xbox has made no public statements as to the game's success on its platform. Data from Ampere Analysis suggested strong initial performance due to the relative ease with which users could set their location to New Zealand and start playing early, with over two million players getting early access on the platform . Subsequent data from Circana indicated that over 56% of global Xbox players had engaged with the game on launch day. Rockstar previously announced that pre-orders for the game totalled 32.5 million units, achieving $3.79 billion in retail sales revenue on its first day , a new record for an entertainment release.

sources.name: PC Gamer
sources.title: Sony: GTA 6 set record for 'highest number of concurrent players for any game on PlayStation' ever
sources.text: The industry is finding new milestones to measure GTA 6's success. GTA 6 has been shattering records since before it came out, becoming the top-rated game in the history of Metacritic before it had the biggest entertainment launch (by dollars) in history. Sony is now joining in that victory lap by sharing GTA 6 milestones as they pertain to PlayStation. "More than 39 million unique players have experienced Jason and Lucia's story in Grand Theft Auto 6 on PlayStation 5," Sony content communications manager Tim Turi wrote in a blog post today. That is a staggering number, especially considering GTA 6 also launched on Xbox and will (eventually) hit PC . But that's not a sales record—Rockstar still has a ways to go to surpass GTA 5's 230 million lifetime sales . What is unprecedented, at least for PlayStation, is GTA 6's concurrents over launch weekend. "GTA 6 set a new record for the highest number of concurrent players for any game on PlayStation, surpassing previous records across multiplayer, free-to-play, and single-player titles," Turi said. That's the wild one to me, because that means more people were playing GTA 6 at the same time on the largest console platform than Call of Duty, GTA 5 , or even Fortnite has ever achieved. Turi didn't share the concurrent figure itself, which is too bad—Steam remains the only platform that hands out exact player data. If the figure is theoretically higher than some of the biggest concurrent peaks we know about on Steam, then it could've been as high as 3-4 million players. On average, those 39 million PS5 players logged 17.4 hours over four days. Let's just say my hour count represents the higher end of that average, and I'm still less than halfway through the main story. sources.title: GTA 6 is "biggest launch in PlayStation history," with Sony reporting over 39 million players on PS5
sources.text: Grand Theft Auto 6 is the "first game played on 70% of new PS5 consoles" GTA 6 isn't just smashing records as the highest-rated game of all time on Metacritic – it's also apparently surpassing massive milestones on consoles like the PlayStation 5. So much so, in fact, that Sony now reports Rockstar's long-awaited new Grand Theft Auto is the "biggest launch in PlayStation history" – ever, ever. That's a nearly 32-year-long history. The company reveals as much in a new blog post , writing, "The launch of GTA 6 marks an extraordinary moment for gaming and entertainment, becoming the biggest game launch in PlayStation history, across three decades and five console generations." Sony goes on to specify just how many players constitute "the biggest" release: "More than 39 million unique players have experienced Jason and Lucia's story in Grand Theft Auto 6 on PlayStation 5." Nearly 40 million. "GTA 6 set a new record for the highest number of concurrent players for any game on PlayStation, surpassing previous records across multiplayer, free-to-play, and single-player titles." That's no small feat, considering this includes… well, everything. From online games like Fortnite to more recent single-player launches like Ghost of Tsushima sequel Ghost of Yotei – and everything before them on every single PlayStation system to date. And, it appears folks helping set this record on PS5 are actually spending quite a bit of time in Grand Theft Auto 6 as well… not just purchasing it. "Across PS5, players cumulatively logged an incredible 683 million hours of gameplay in GTA 6," as Sony writes," reflecting the enthusiasm of the PlayStation community. Each player has spent an average of 17.4 hours exploring the state of Leonida during the game's opening days." That's not bad, considering just how behemoth-like Rockstar seems. It's only been a few days, and the community is clearly engaging with it. GTA 6 is boosting console sales, too. Sony apparently "saw the largest number of newly connected PS5 consoles on a single day since the console's launch, outside of end-of-year holidays." And, "since its launch, GTA 6 was the first game played on 70% of new PS5 consoles." This all checks out – heck, following the GTA 6 extended look on Netflix in August, we saw a surge in both PS5 and Xbox Series X sales . When it comes to the new Grand Theft Auto, we're talking about a mind-boggling $3.79 billion launch across platforms – and it's not even out on PC yet. sources.name: Gematsu
sources.title: Acts of Blood for PC delayed to spring 2027
sources.text: Publisher Big Fan Games and developer Eksil Team have delayed beat ’em up action game Acts of Blood from its previously planned December 4, 2026 release to spring 2027 for PC via Steam and Microsoft Store . PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series versions are also due out in 2027. Here is the full message from Eksil Team on the delay: With heavy heart we’re making a difficult decision to postpone the release of the game on PC (Steam) into spring 2027. We know the decision might disappoint for you, whom already looking forward to play our game on December. But after assessing the feedback we got from players, play testers, and internal team, we found several issues that still can be improved with a little bit more time, and hopefully it will deliver the best experience we intended.

sources.title: GTA 6 lança álbum com 34 músicas de Lana Del Rey, Dua Lipa e Travis Scott; veja lista
sources.text: A Rockstar Games e a Atlantic Records lançaram oficialmente Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album , trilha sonora de GTA 6 que reúne 34 músicas originais de artistas como Lana Del Rey, Dua Lipa, Travis Scott, Cardi B, JENNIE e Playboi Carti. O álbum já está disponível nas plataformas digitais e também ganhou edições especiais em CD e vinil. A seleção musical acompanha a atmosfera de Vice City e do estado fictício de Leonida, cenários do novo jogo da franquia. Entre as faixas estão “Crazy For You”, de Lana Del Rey, “Go Easy”, de Dua Lipa, “RHYNO”, de Travis Scott, e “Don’t Chart”, de Cardi B. A trilha também conta com participações de Rauw Alejandro, Burna Boy, Don Toliver, Kali Uchis, Zara Larsson e CA7RIEL & Paco Amoroso. A música sempre foi uma parte importante da identidade de Grand Theft Auto , principalmente pelas estações de rádio que acompanham os jogadores durante a exploração das cidades. Em GTA 6, a Rockstar amplia essa tradição com novas rádios, trilha sonora dinâmica e um repertório que reúne diferentes gêneros musicais. Além do lançamento digital, Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album ganhou edições físicas especiais, incluindo um vinil de edição limitada preenchido com líquido, uma versão com efeito splatter e um CD com estojo tradicional. Também foram anunciadas versões exclusivas para varejistas como Amazon, Walmart, Best Buy e Target, com diferentes prensagens e pôsteres. Para celebrar o lançamento, foi anunciado o evento Grand Theft Auto VI: The Festival , realizado em 21 de novembro, no Mana Wynwood, em Miami. A programação divulgada incluiu artistas da trilha sonora, como Travis Scott, Cardi B, Rauw Alejandro, Metro Boomin, Justice, Kodak Black e CA7RIEL & Paco Amoroso.
